title: NoteMD template front matter
description: YAML front matter of a NoteMD template note (a reusable prompt). Parse the YAML between the --- lines to JSON, then validate it. A note becomes a template when it has `params` or `template: true`. Regular notes use #/$defs/note.

note.title: NoteMD note front matter
note.description: Front matter of any note. Every key is optional. Other keys are kept as written and listed in the preview's front matter table.

title.description: Display title. Without it, the note uses its first `# heading`, then its file name.

tags.description: Tags, without `#`. Matching ignores case. The app also reads a comma-separated string and the `tag` key, but writes a list.

template.description: Marks the note as a template even without parameters. Not needed when `params` is present.

params.description: The template's form fields, in form order. The app also reads the key `parameters`, but writes `params`.

parameter.title: Template parameter
parameter.description: One form field. Its value replaces `{{name}}` in the note body.

name.description: Placeholder name used as {{name}}. Letters, digits, `_`, `-` or `.`, starting with a letter or `_`. Unique within the template. `this` is reserved for loop items.

type.description: Field type; `text` when omitted. The app also reads aliases (string, select, bool, array, …), but writes these names.

label.description: Field label. Defaults to the name humanized (`game_name` → `Game name`).

required.description: The form refuses to produce output until this field has a value. Text-like fields need non-blank text, lists need an item.

help.description: Hint shown under the field. The app also reads `description`.

placeholder.description: Example value shown in an empty text, textarea, number, file, folder or list field.

options.description: The choices of a `choice` or `multichoice` field. The app also reads `choices` and `values`.

format.description: Unicode date pattern for a `date` field, e.g. `d MMMM yyyy`. Defaults to `yyyy-MM-dd`.

default.description: Initial value; its type depends on `type`. A `choice` starts on its first option when omitted, a `date` on today.
`today`, or a fixed date as YYYY-MM-DD.
